summary: This study tested how the drug Henagliflozin affects brain and sense of smell function in older adults with type 2 diabetes and mild memory issues. Mild cognitive impairment means a slight decline in mental abilities like memory and thinking. Researchers looked at brain activity changes triggered by odors using special brain scan pictures. The study enrolled 24 participants to compare treatments over time.
